sourceTemplate.creator: Daniel Shashko
sourceTemplate.adaptation: Two catalog parser nodes preserved unchanged. Direct public GET replaces Bright Data; manual trigger, snapshot comparison and catalog QA replace Gmail delivery and Data Tables.

scope: First 12 products from each of two public storefront feeds. Independent research; neither brand is a client. Public feed gaps are review prompts, not confirmed storefront defects. No private inventory quantities, sales data, or customer records accessed.

comparison.note: First capture establishes a baseline. No historical price-change claim.
